name: Test Taxonomy and Coverage Baseline
description: Define the test taxonomy classifying tests by scope (unit, integration, contract, e2e), technique (property-based, state-machine, fuzzing, chaos), and target (desktop, PWA, compute, protocol, storage). Establish current coverage baseline across all packages using instrumentation or static analysis and publish a report identifying gaps.
purpose: Before quality engineering can improve test coverage or enforce release gates, the project needs a shared vocabulary for what kinds of tests exist and a measured baseline of current coverage. Without taxonomy, teams use inconsistent terminology; without baseline, there is no way to measure improvement or detect regression in test coverage over time.
acceptanceCriteria: Published test taxonomy document with classification dimensions (scope, technique, target) and examples from the codebase
Coverage baseline report for all first-party packages showing line coverage, branch coverage, and test count per taxonomy category
Gap analysis identifying package-category combinations with zero coverage and prioritized remediation recommendations
